source._comment: LIVE (statewide only). NJ's Division of Elections publishes no pre-election mail-ballot counts (its county 'periodic reports' begin on Election Day). The UF Election Lab receives the state's figures directly and publishes them daily; nj_update.py uses the NJ row of the Lab's CSV unaltered, with attribution, under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (credit, non-commercial, no modification). County-level sources are being investigated; if enough counties publish, they can replace this.
